changelog: Windows: устранена петля маршрутизации — интернет больше не пропадает при подключении. Адаптер больше не клонируется при каждом запуске. Появилась регистрация и восстановление пароля.
_notes: Update manifest for Desktop, Android and the extension. Clients poll this
at start-up and every 4 hours, compare semver against their own version,
and show a banner only when this file is strictly newer.
It deliberately reports the version that is actually published right now,
not the next planned one. Publishing a higher number before the installer
exists would show every user an update banner pointing at a 404, which is
worse than showing nothing at all.
1. build the installer and the APK, upload them to site/downloads/
2. bump version + build here, write a one-line changelog in Russian
3. set releaseDate, and point downloads.* at the new file names
4. raise minSupportedVersion only to force an upgrade (it turns the
banner into a blocking notice), never routinely
Download paths are site-relative on purpose: the same manifest then works
unchanged on beta and behind any future mirror.
